# Astronomical 0.2.54
This release fixes local image generation quality on macOS.
## What changed
Image generation now renders on each model's canonical diffusion schedule instead of a pinned four-step count.
The local image generation endpoint previously forced a single four-step denoising schedule for every image-generation model. A model whose reference schedule is longer was rendered with only four steps, producing results with muted, streaked, or ghosted detail. The diffusion schedule is now a per-model-family discovery fact, so each model uses its own reference count — for example Qwen Image 2.1 runs its canonical 40 steps, and FLUX.2 Klein runs its four-step reference schedule. Full image quality is restored for every image-generation model.
The local `POST /v1/images/generations` request no longer accepts the optional `steps` and `guidance` fields. A mistuned step count can quarter-denoise a render while every structural check still passes, so the schedule is owned by the model family rather than exposed as a caller control.
## Compatibility
- The local `POST /v1/images/generations` endpoint no longer reads `steps` or `guidance` from requests. Callers that sent them were already limited to a single hard-coded value; the endpoint now derives the correct count from the model family. - Request validation is otherwise unchanged: image dimensions stay within 64–1024 pixels in multiples of 16, `n` stays one, and `response_format` stays `b64_json`.
## Preserved
- Model selection, resolution validation, and seeded, deterministic output are unchanged. - No local state, caches, or user settings are affected.
## Distribution
Astronomical 0.2.54 is distributed as a code-signed, Hardened Runtime, notarized macOS `.dmg`. The GitHub release asset and the Sparkle update feed enclosure are pinned to their SHA-256 digests, and the live signed update feed is updated after publication.
